mentions.name: Item Forge
mentions.description: This app creates and prints cards for Dungeons & Dragons magic items, so players can be handed a printed card for each magic item they receive during in-person sessions.
mentions.problem: The group's players are quite new to the game, so printed reference cards help them with the magic items they receive.
mentions.audience: The author's in-person Dungeons & Dragons group, including players who are quite new to the game
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I build these two app to create items and spell cards and print them out.

https://www.item-forge.org/
